title: דאני לי מארחת את שורד השואה אברהם רוט- FIGHTING TO REMEMBER

answers.label: What time period does this story cover?
answers.answer: The story covers Avraham's life from his birth in 1928 through the events of the Second World War.

answers.label: What feeling or message do you want to come through?
answers.answer: Avraham wants the world to remember what happened, not to forget, and not to forgive. He hopes to ensure that such atrocities never happen again.

answers.label: What's your relationship to the person this story is about?
What name were they born with, and what were they called growing up?
When and where were they born?
answers.answer: He was born in Holland in 1928.

answers.label: Who were the close and extended family around them?
answers.answer: He grew up in a family with six children, including two sisters and four boys. His grandfather also lived nearby in a large house.

answers.label: Did religion, tradition, or culture shape their everyday life?
answers.answer: He came from an Orthodox liberal family. They were educated to believe that all people are equal, which made the Holocaust unimaginable to them.

answers.label: Where was the family during the war?
answers.answer: The family initially lived in Holland and was forced into a ghetto in 1943. Later, the brothers were hidden on separate farms in the south of Holland.

answers.label: Was there a song, phrase, or story that gave them strength?
Was there a moment they had to make a hard decision?
answers.answer: Avraham's mother had to make the quick decision to lie to the Germans during a night raid. She claimed he had cholera, which successfully scared them into leaving the family alone.

answers.label: Did anyone help or support them along the way?
answers.answer: The Dutch underground helped hide Avraham and his brothers on various farms. Additionally, a Catholic priest convinced local farmers to hide Jewish children, saving about 200 of them.

answers.label: Why does it matter to you to share this now?
answers.answer: Avraham regrets that his family never spoke about the Holocaust at home due to their deep trauma. He feels it is his lifelong task to tell people what happened.

answers.label: What would you want future generations to take from it?
answers.answer: He wants future generations to remember the reality of the war and never forget. He hopes that by sharing these experiences, history will not repeat itself.

answers.label: What do you hope listeners carry with them?
answers.answer: Listeners should understand that the horrors of war were real, not just scenes from a video game. They must carry this legacy forward and deliver the message to the next generations.

events.title: Early Life and Persecution
events.description: Avraham is born into an Orthodox liberal family in Holland. His peaceful life ends when the Germans arrive and begin stripping Jews of their basic rights.

events.title: Invasion and Jewish School
events.description: The sudden bombing of Holland takes everyone by surprise. Avraham attends a segregated Jewish school where classmates and teachers frequently disappear.

events.title: Ghettos and Deportations
events.description: Avraham's family is forced into a ghetto, and he witnesses the brutal deportation of orphans. His mother temporarily saves them from a raid by claiming he has cholera.

events.title: Hiding and Battle of Arnhem
events.description: The Dutch underground helps hide Avraham and his brothers on separate farms. While in hiding, he witnesses American paratroopers fighting and dying during the Battle of Arnhem.

events.title: Trauma and Legacy
events.description: Avraham explains why his family never spoke about the Holocaust at home due to their deep trauma. He emphasizes the importance of sharing his story so future generations never forget.
